propDocs.NumberInput.value: Controlled number, or null for an empty field.
propDocs.NumberInput.step: Amount added or removed by one step.
propDocs.NumberInput.readOnly: Retains focus and submission while preventing changes.
propDocs.NumberInput.required: Requires a number when submitted in a form.
propDocs.NumberInput.wheel: Allows wheel events to step a focused input.
propDocs.NumberInputScrubArea.orientation: Horizontal scrubbing increases to the right; vertical increases upwards.
